            <h2 class="section-title mb-3">Sinopsis Anime Sakamoto Days</h2>
                        <div class="prose prose-invert prose-sm md:prose-base max-w-none text-ink-100">Sakamoto Days Tarou Sakamoto was considered the greatest hitman of all time. Feared by many, he stood at the top of the underground world until he met and fell in love with a woman. As a result, Sakamoto abandoned his life of crime and now works as a convenience store clerk. Leaving his shady past behind proves more difficult than Sakamoto initially imagined. Many of his former rivals and partners do not believe that he has truly left the business and show up in hopes of taking him out. Barred from killing, Sakamoto must find creative ways to subdue his enemies and prevent them from bringing harm to his family, his store, and the small town he resides in. [Written by MAL Rewrite]</div>

<script>
    function episodeList(cfg) {
        return {
            range: cfg.range, sort: cfg.sort, q: '', notFound: false, last: null,
            init() {
                try { this.sort = localStorage.getItem('eplist_sort') || this.sort; } catch (e) {}
                try { this.last = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('eplist_last_' + cfg.series) || 'null'); } catch (e) {}
                const cur = this.$root.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]');
                const slugOf = (a) => new URL(a.href).pathname.replace(/^\//, '');
                if (cur) {
                    try { localStorage.setItem('eplist_last_' + cfg.series, JSON.stringify({ slug: slugOf(cur), n: cur.dataset.n })); } catch (e) {}
                } else if (this.last) {
                    const a = Array.from(this.$root.querySelectorAll('.ept')).find(x => slugOf(x) === this.last.slug);
                    if (a) {
                        a.classList.add('last');
                        const grids = [...new Set(Array.from(this.$root.querySelectorAll('.ept')).map(x => x.parentElement))];
                        this.range = grids.indexOf(a.parentElement);
                    }
                }
            },
            toggleSort() {
                this.sort = this.sort === 'desc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';
                try { localStorage.setItem('eplist_sort', this.sort); } catch (e) {}
            },
            jump(go) {
                this.notFound = false;
                const v = String(this.q || '').trim();
                if (!v) return;
                const el = this.$root.querySelector('[data-n="' + CSS.escape(String(parseFloat(v))) + '"]');
                if (!el) { this.notFound = true; return; }
                if (go) { window.location.href = el.href; return; }
                const grids = Array.from(this.$root.querySelectorAll('[data-n]')).map(a => a.parentElement);
                this.range = [...new Set(grids)].indexOf(el.parentElement);
                this.$nextTick(() => {
                    el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
                    el.classList.remove('eplist-flash'); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('eplist-flash');
                });
            },
        };
    }
</script>
            </section>

    <script type="module">
    import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.2/firebase-app.js";
    import { getMessaging, getToken, onMessage, isSupported } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.2/firebase-messaging.js";

    const fcmCfg = {"apiKey":"AIzaSyBKkqeYgR0uxOtvkh8tQ-Z3wlwKSi5ra7k","authDomain":"gomunime-app.firebaseapp.com","projectId":"gomunime-app","storageBucket":"gomunime-app.firebasestorage.app","messagingSenderId":"60183386668","appId":"1:60183386668:web:5bc860a1e15cad33ad4f89","measurementId":"G-NHTBS5K64P"};
    const VAPID_KEY = "BGis5Za_gtOkdSvFeR-Rnj7_gXjeLKyrBPYW9B41YAs3UaDHPsmnRONPCRzV2Cu34BpwcvMkM9-b9TeZL_O4ghI";

    const STORAGE = {
        token: 'gomu_fcm_token_v2',
        denied: 'gomu_push_denied_at',
        promptShown: 'gomu_push_prompt_at',
        pageViews: 'gomu_pv_count',
    };

    // Increment page view counter — drives engagement-based prompt timing.
    try {
        const pv = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE.pageViews) || '0', 10) + 1;
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE.pageViews, String(pv));
    } catch (_) {}

    const URL_PARAMS = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    const DEBUG = URL_PARAMS.has('debug_push');
    const INSTANT = URL_PARAMS.has('fcm_now');  // bypass all gates, request immediately
    const log = (...a) => (DEBUG || INSTANT) && console.log('[FCM]', ...a);

    (async () => {
        log('init start, pv=' + localStorage.getItem(STORAGE.pageViews));
        if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator) || !('Notification' in window)) { log('no SW or Notification API'); return; }
        if (!(await isSupported().catch(() => false))) { log('isSupported returned false'); return; }

        const app = initializeApp(fcmCfg);
        const messaging = getMessaging(app);
        log('Firebase initialized');

        // Dedicated scope so the PWA service worker (sw.js at scope '/') can NEVER displace
        // the FCM worker — both registering at '/' was last-writer-wins, and when the
        // handler-less PWA SW won, pushes were silently swallowed.
        const swReg = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/firebase-messaging-sw.js', {
            scope: '/firebase-cloud-messaging-push-scope',
        }).catch(e => {
            console.warn('FCM SW register failed', e);
            return null;
        });
        if (!swReg) { log('SW reg failed'); return; }
        log('SW registered, scope=' + swReg.scope);

        // Show OS notif when message arrives in foreground (tab visible).
        // Use SW.showNotification() — `new Notification()` is unreliable in modern Chrome.
        onMessage(messaging, (payload) => {
            log('foreground message arrived', payload);
            if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') return;
            const t = payload.notification?.title || payload.data?.title || 'Gomunime';
            const opts = {
                body: payload.notification?.body || payload.data?.body || '',
                icon: '/icons/icon-192.png',
                badge: '/icons/icon-192.png',
                data: payload.data || {},
                tag: payload.data?.tag || 'gomunime-fg',
            };
            swReg.showNotification(t, opts).catch(e => console.warn('showNotification failed', e));
        });

        log('permission=' + Notification.permission);

        // If user already granted permission, refresh token quietly.
        if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
            await refreshAndSendToken(messaging, swReg);
            return;
        }

        // Don't bother nagging users who explicitly blocked.
        if (Notification.permission === 'denied') { log('permission denied, skip'); return; }

        // permission === 'default' → minta izin NATIVE LANGSUNG begitu web dibuka (instan, no delay).
        const denyAge = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE.denied) || '0', 10);
        if (!INSTANT && denyAge && (Date.now() - denyAge) < 7 * 86400000) { log('denied recently, back off 7d'); return; }
        log('requesting permission immediately');
        const perm = await Notification.requestPermission();
        log('permission result=' + perm);
        if (perm === 'granted') await refreshAndSendToken(messaging, swReg);
        else localStorage.setItem(STORAGE.denied, String(Date.now()));
    })().catch(e => console.warn('FCM init error', e));

    async function refreshAndSendToken(messaging, swReg) {
        try {
            const token = await getToken(messaging, {
                vapidKey: VAPID_KEY,
                serviceWorkerRegistration: swReg,
            });
            if (!token) return;
            const prev = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE.token);
            if (token === prev) return; // already saved
            await fetch('/api/v1/push/subscribe', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    'Accept': 'application/json',
                },
                body: JSON.stringify({ token, topic: 'gomunime_all' }),
            });
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE.token, token);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn('FCM getToken failed', e);
        }
    }

    function showPrompt(messaging, swReg) {
        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.id = 'gomu-push-prompt';
        el.innerHTML = `
            <div style="position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;max-width:380px;margin-left:auto;background:#0a0a0a;border:1px solid #003bff44;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px -8px rgba(0,59,255,.4);z-index:9999;color:#fff;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif">
              <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start">
                <div style="font-size:24px;line-height:1">🔔</div>
                <div style="flex:1;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45">
                  <div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px">Aktifkan notifikasi episode baru?</div>
                  <div style="opacity:.8">Dapat update episode anime favoritmu langsung di browser — bisa dimatikan kapan saja.</div>
                  <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:10px">
                    <button data-act="ok" style="flex:1;background:#003bff;color:#fff;border:0;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer">Aktifkan</button>
                    <button data-act="no" style="background:transparent;color:#888;border:0;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer">Nanti saja</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        document.body.appendChild(el);
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE.promptShown, String(Date.now()));

        el.querySelector('[data-act="ok"]').onclick = async () => {
            el.remove();
            const perm = await Notification.requestPermission();
            if (perm === 'granted') {
                await refreshAndSendToken(messaging, swReg);
            } else {
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE.denied, String(Date.now()));
            }
        };
        el.querySelector('[data-act="no"]').onclick = () => {
            el.remove();
            localStorage.setItem(STORAGE.denied, String(Date.now()));
        };
    }
</script>
